title: CONNECT-UDP Target Filtering Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9298 vulnerable-target filtering surface.
scope: This verification covers rejection classification for loopback, link-local, multicast, broadcast, unspecified, and proxy-local addresses, acceptance of non-vulnerable documentation-prefix targets, and Proxy-Status `destination_ip_prohibited` field creation.
preconditions: RFC 9298 target host syntax validation is trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9298-0001`.
expected_result: The focused target-policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 target-filtering artifacts, generated triage reflects the slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9298 vulnerable-target filtering and Proxy-Status helper surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. DNS resolution and live UDP socket opening remain future RFC 9298 slices.
